Here's my assessment:

---

## Vitest Config Assessment

**Repo files reviewed:**
1. `vitest.config.ts` — main test runner config
2. `vitest.benchmark.config.mts` — benchmark test runner config

**Repo vitest version:** `^2.1.4` (`package.json:40`)

**Current upstream version:** v5.0.0 (per [vitest.dev/config](https://vitest.dev/config/))

---

### Options inventory (both files share the same shape)

| Option | File(s) | Upstream status (v5 docs) |
|---|---|---|
| `resolve.alias` | both (top-level) | **Current** — Vite option, still valid. [vite.dev/config/shared-options](https://vite.dev/config/shared-options) |
| `ssr.external` | both (top-level) | **Current** — Vite SSR option, still valid. [vite.dev/config/ssr-options](https://vite.dev/config/ssr-options) |
| `test.environment` | both | **Current** — [vitest.dev/config/environment](https://vitest.dev/config/environment) |
| `test.include` | both | **Current** — [vitest.dev/config/include](https://vitest.dev/config/include) |
| `testTimeout` | both | **Current** — [vitest.dev/config/testtimeout](https://vitest.dev/config/testtimeout) |
| `hookTimeout` | benchmark only | **Current** — [vitest.dev/config/hooktimeout](https://vitest.dev/config/hooktimeout) |
| `test.server.deps.external` | both | **Deprecated** — see finding below |

---

### Finding: `server` is deprecated in Vitest v5

The [vitest.dev/config/server](https://vitest.dev/config/server) page carries this heading and warning:

> **server deprecated** — Before Vitest 4, this option was used to define the configuration for the `vite-node` server.

The page notes the option still exists and documents `server.deps.external`, `server.deps.inline`, and `server.deps.fallbackCJS` as sub-options. So `server.deps.external: ["node:sqlite"]` still **works** in v5, but lives under a deprecated parent. There is no documented replacement — the page says these options "should be used only as the last resort."

**Impact on this repo:** Since the repo pins `^2.1.4`, this is a non-issue right now. It would become relevant only when upgrading to v4+. The `node:sqlite` externalization is still needed regardless of where the option lands in the future.

**All other options are current and not deprecated, renamed, or behaving differently in v5.**

---

### What I verified

- `vitest.dev/config` main page and sidebar (v5.0.0)
- `vitest.dev/config/server` — confirmed deprecation notice, confirmed `server.deps.external` still documented
- `vitest.dev/config/deps` — confirmed no conflicting `deps.external` option
- `vite.dev/config/ssr-options` — confirmed `ssr.external` is a Vite option, still valid
- `vitest.dev/config/testtimeout`, `hooktimeout`, `environment`, `include` — all confirmed present in v5 sidebar and docs
